# exo_on_premises_organization (Resource)

Manages the OnPremisesOrganization object via New-OnPremisesOrganization / Get-OnPremisesOrganization / Set-OnPremisesOrganization / Remove-OnPremisesOrganization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hybrid_domains` (String) Maps to the -HybridDomains parameter.
- `inbound_connector` (String) Maps to the -InboundConnector parameter.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
- `organization_guid` (String) Maps to the -OrganizationGuid parameter.
- `outbound_connector` (String) Maps to the -OutboundConnector parameter.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `organization_name` (String) Maps to the -OrganizationName parameter.
- `organization_relationship` (String) Maps to the -OrganizationRelationship parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
